name: Coca-Cola UNITED - Montgomery Production Plant, AL

fieldNotes.location: Roster lat/lng (32.294107,-86.347673, GEOMETRIC_CENTER) and roster address (2000 Coca Cola Rd) geocoded to a street centerline on empty land. The real facility is the Coca-Cola UNITED Montgomery Production Plant, 300 Coca-Cola Road, Montgomery AL 36105 - a $35M Dasani/beverage production facility opened 2016, ~120 associates, ~25M cases/year. Building positively identified ~32.2930,-86.3428; Street View shows the red 'Coca-Cola' logo and a branded canopied truck gate.
fieldNotes.truckGate: STRONG positive. Street View shows a large canopied gatehouse spanning multiple lanes off Coca-Cola Road, with the red Coca-Cola script logo on the canopy, gate barrier arms across the lanes, and a 'Do Not Enter' sign on an outbound lane. Fully controlled truck entrance.
fieldNotes.guardShack: STRONG positive. A staffed guard booth structure sits beneath the gate canopy between the lanes - clearly visible in Street View. guardShack=true.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: false - a guard shack is present, so this is not a remote/kiosk gate.
fieldNotes.entryLanes/exitLanes: The canopied gate spans multiple lanes (~2 in, ~2 out) with the booth in the middle; counts approximate from Street View, flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide multi-lane canopied gate apron with room for an express/bypass lane. fastLaneOpportunity=true.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: ~30 dock doors with trailers backed in along the production building's south face plus the NW warehouse - band 25-50, approximate.
fieldNotes.dropArea: 25-50 trailers parked without tractors in the north trailer yard inside the gate.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Paved holding area between the gate canopy and the trailer yard/docks - inside the gate, before the docks.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Docks read as a single cluster along the building's south face; no clearly separate ship/receive bank. shipRcvSeparate=false.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur enters the property; I-65 borders the SE side. railServed=false.
fieldNotes.buildingCount: Main production building (with attached office) plus a separate NW warehouse = 2.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Within the Montgomery metro on the I-65 corridor with adjacent residential subdivisions - Urban.
